### Father and Son Reunited
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/father-and-son-reunited
Passage: Genesis 46:28-30
Points:
- The tender reunion of Jacob and Joseph illustrates the profound human joy of being reunited with loved ones after years of separation.
- Joseph’s status and royal chariot highlight his humility and gracious forgiveness toward the brothers who once mistreated him.
- Seeing Joseph alive gave Jacob peace in facing death, pointing believers to the resurrected Christ who removes the sting of death.
- Judah’s role in guiding the family forward reflects personal restoration and faintly foreshadows Christ bringing God's people together.
- Christians are called to reflect God’s mercy by taking active steps to pursue reconciliation with estranged friends and family.
